entries.description: Value shown when the phone is connected to the patch over Bluetooth.

entries.description: Value shown when a patch exists but the phone is not currently connected over Bluetooth.

entries.description: Status shown when no patch is activated or paired. Value of the connection row.

entries.ui_location: Overview > Carelevo pump tab > pump info table
entries.description: Label of the row with the active temporary basal rate in units per hour. Temp basal is a short-term change to the basal rate.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo patch activation wizard > Patch Started step
entries.description: Heading telling the user to fill the patch with insulin before activating it.

entries.ui_location: Overview > Carelevo pump tab > pump info table
entries.description: Label of the row with the total insulin delivered by the patch so far, in units.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo alarm notification > action button
entries.description: Short confirm button on Carelevo alarm notifications that only need acknowledging (low battery, expiring patch, Bluetooth off and so on). Tapping it clears the alarm.

entries.ui_location: Overview > Carelevo pump tab > pump info table
entries.description: Basal rate; %.2f is insulin units per hour (U/hr). Used for the basal and temp basal rate rows.

entries.ui_location: Overview > Carelevo pump tab > pump info table
entries.description: Insulin amount with its unit; %s is a number of insulin units (U). Used for remaining, total and delivered insulin. Keep the space between value and unit if your language uses one.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo notification > check blood glucose
entries.description: Duration text, %d hours. Inserted into the 'check blood glucose' notice as the time since the last bolus.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo notification > check blood glucose
entries.description: Duration text, %1$d hours and %2$d minutes. Inserted into the 'check blood glucose' notice as the time since the last bolus.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo notification > check blood glucose
entries.description: Duration text, %d minutes. Inserted into the 'check blood glucose' notice as the time since the last bolus.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo patch activation wizard > Safety Check step > progress
entries.description: Countdown while the safety check runs: %1$d minutes and %2$02d seconds left.

entries.ui_location: Overview > Carelevo pump tab > Patch Time Remaining row
entries.description: Time left on the patch: %1$d days, then hours and minutes as hh:mm. Example: 3 days 04:15.

entries.ui_location: Overview > Carelevo pump tab > Patch Time Remaining row
entries.description: Time left on the patch as hh:mm, both zero-padded, used when less than a day remains. Example: 03:07. Usually not translated.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo patch activation wizard > Set insulin amount step
entries.description: Allowed fill range in insulin units: %1$d is the minimum, %2$d the maximum. Example: Range : 50 ~ 300 U.

entries.ui_location: Carelevo patch activation wizard > Set insulin amount step
entries.description: Title asking the user to choose how much insulin they filled into the patch.
